sources.masses: Huang and Zhou, 'Precise values of running quark and lepton masses in the Standard Model', Phys. Rev. D 103, 016010 (2021), arXiv:2009.04851v2 (13 Jan 2021); the PDF https://arxiv.org/pdf/2009.04851 fetched 2026-10-09, sha256 baeddc972002d60140ec54a8a2d378c51bc5e94ca8af9ac97c1164ff1621ceb6. Table 2 (quarks) and Table 3 (charged leptons), the row 'MZ, Full SM': the MS-bar running masses at mu = M_Z = 91.1876 GeV in the full Standard Model (six quarks and three leptons active), defined there above the electroweak scale as m_f = y_f v_F / sqrt(2) with v_F = 246 GeV. Each uncertainty is the printed sqrt(delta_exp^2 + delta_trunc^2). Their inputs are PDG 2020 (Zyla et al., their reference [5]).
sources.transcription: Copied by hand from the PDF's text layer (pdftotext -layout), the values exactly as printed, then converted to GeV. Not computed here.

scheme: MS-bar, full Standard Model, m_f = y_f v_F / sqrt(2), v_F = 246 GeV
